name: Massachusetts Free Legal Answers
provider: American Bar Association (ABA Free Legal Answers)
description: A free online legal advice clinic: qualifying users post non-criminal (civil) legal questions, such as family, divorce, custody, housing, eviction, homelessness and consumer rights, and volunteer lawyers answer them. You get an email when there is a response. The lawyers cannot call you or represent you in court, and an answer is not promised before a court date or deadline.
contact: Online only through https://mass.freelegalanswers.org/ (no phone number listed)

requirements.text: You answer a few questions on the site to see if you qualify to use the service. Register for yourself only, not for someone else.
Only non-criminal (civil) legal questions. Volunteer lawyers can't call you and can't represent you in court.
If you already have a court date or other important legal deadline, an answer is not promised before that day.

unknowns: The qualifying rules (income, age, residency) are not stated on the home page

first_step.title: Check if you qualify and post your question
first_step.detail: On mass.freelegalanswers.org, answer a few questions to see if you qualify, create an account, then ask your civil legal question. You will get an email when a volunteer lawyer responds.
